brief.zh: 按阅读顺序（先左后右，再从上到下），亮块排在暗块前面就整张图输出 1，否则输出 0。第二个输入是每格所在图块的编号 0 … 15。
brief.en: In reading order (left to right, then top to bottom), if the bright patch comes before the dark one, output 1 over the whole image; otherwise output 0. The second input is the number of the patch each pixel is in, 0 … 15.

hint.zh: Q、K 决定看谁，V 决定带回什么。要让结果知道亮块和暗块各在哪儿，位置该从哪一路进来？
hint.en: Q and K decide whom to look at; V decides what comes back. For the result to know where the bright and dark patches sit, which input should carry the position?

after.zh: 没有位置时，把两个图块对调，注意力的输出也只是跟着对调：它看到的是一袋图块，不是一串。你给每个图块加上了它的编号乘一个小数：这叫位置编码 z̃ᵢ = zᵢ + pᵢ，每个图块带着自己的地址，顺序才进得了计算。ViT 在进入第一层之前就把位置加到每个图块上。
after.en: Without position, swap two patches and attention's output just swaps with them: it sees a bag of patches, not a sequence. You added each patch's number times a small amount: this is a positional encoding z̃ᵢ = zᵢ + pᵢ, so every patch carries its own address and order can enter the computation. ViT adds the position to every patch before the first layer.

t.zh: 「狗咬人」和「人咬狗」用的是同样的字，意思却相反，差别全在顺序。图也一样：左边亮右边暗，和反过来，是两张不同的图。
t.en: "Dog bites man" and "man bites dog" use the same words but mean opposite things; the difference is all in the order. Images are the same: bright on the left and dark on the right is a different image from the reverse.

t.zh: <level-ref to="5-1"></level-ref>的注意力按「长得像不像」分配权重，它清楚每个图块是什么样子。可它知道这块排在第几吗？先想一想：把两个图块对调，注意力的输出会怎样？
t.en: The attention from <level-ref to="5-1"></level-ref> shares out its weights by how alike patches look, so it knows what each patch looks like. But does it know where a patch comes in the order? Think first: if you swap two patches, what happens to the attention output?

t.zh: 这一关多了一个输入：每一格所在图块的编号，按阅读顺序从 0 数到 15。
t.en: This level has an extra input: the number of the patch each cell is in, counting 0 to 15 in reading order.

t.zh: 测试图是一片灰，里面有一块亮、一块暗。按先左后右、再从上到下的顺序，亮块在前就整张输出 1，否则输出 0。测试是成对的：同样两块，只换了位置。
t.en: Each test image is grey with one bright patch and one dark patch. Reading left to right, then top to bottom, output 1 everywhere if the bright patch comes first, otherwise 0. The tests come in pairs: the same two patches with their positions swapped.

caption.zh: 亮块是第 2 块，暗块是第 3 块：亮在前，期望全是 1
caption.en: The bright patch is number 2 and the dark one number 3: bright comes first, so expect all 1s
